description: Change where and how a chat app bridge answers (PATCH /v1/bridges/{id}); send only what changes, at least one of allowed, requireMention, sessionScope and settings. allowed REPLACES the whole list of chats, channels or rooms the bridge answers in (1-50, never empty: pause it instead): keep the current ones from thalovant_get_bridge, add rows from thalovant_list_bridge_chats, or type ids matching the chat app's targets.pattern. Setting allowed the first time starts a bridge in setup. requireMention false makes it answer every message in its groups, which spends the daily allowance faster; a Discord bridge always needs a mention (422 bridge_mention_required). sessionScope person gives each person a conversation of their own, chat one per chat. settings are the chat app's non-secret settings (its settings form in thalovant_list_chat_app_connectors), merged into the stored ones and checked again; an address must be https on port 443 with a public host. A token or secret is never a setting: a setting name that looks like one is refused here before any request, and tokens and secrets are replaced in the Thalovant console: open the bot from Connections or the hub's Chat apps tab and use Replace token. To pause or resume, use thalovant_pause_bridge or thalovant_resume_bridge. Needs a paid plan. Requires the hubs:write scope, and the hub's owner or a workspace manager.

allowed.description: Every chat the bridge should answer in, 1-50; replaces the stored list.

guild_id.description: Discord: the server the channel belongs to.

id.description: The chat, channel or room id: a row's id from thalovant_list_bridge_chats, or typed to match the chat app's targets.pattern.

kind.description: The row's kind, for display only.

title.description: The chat's name, for display only.

apiUrl.description: Control-plane base URL. Configured credentials may only be used on their configured origin; defaults to https://api.thalovant.com.

bridgeId.description: Bridge UUID: the id from thalovant_list_bridges.

etag.description: Optional. The bridge's etag, read from the `etag` field of thalovant_get_bridge (the API sends no ETag header), sent as If-Match: a bridge changed since fails with HTTP 412 and nothing changes. Leave it out to change the bridge as it is now.

loginScope.description: Optional login scope used with THALOVANT_EMAIL and THALOVANT_PASSWORD.

requireMention.description: Answer only messages that mention the bot or reply to it. Discord bridges are always true.

sessionScope.description: person: each person has a conversation of their own; chat: one conversation per chat.

settings.description: Non-secret settings to change, at most 32, by the setting keys of the chat app's settings form; merged into the stored ones.

name: thalovant_update_bridge
title: Update Chat App Bridge
